shortDescription: SSC CGL Syllabus 2026 – Tier 1 (100 Q, 200 marks) and Tier 2 Paper-I modules with detailed subjects.
content:
SSC CGL selection is based on Computer Based Examinations in two tiers.

Tier-I Exam Pattern

  • General Intelligence & Reasoning – 25 Q, 50 marks
  • General Awareness – 25 Q, 50 marks
  • Quantitative Aptitude – 25 Q, 50 marks
  • English Comprehension – 25 Q, 50 marks

Total: 100 Q · 200 marks · 60 minutes. Negative marking: 0.50 per wrong answer.

Tier-I Syllabus (indicative)

  • Reasoning: Analogies, Coding-Decoding, Series, Syllogism, Venn, Non-verbal, Spatial orientation
  • GA: History, Culture, Geography, Economy, Polity, Science, Current Affairs, Static GK
  • Quant: Number System, Percentage, Ratio, Algebra, Geometry, Mensuration, Trigonometry, DI
  • English: Grammar, Vocabulary, Comprehension, Error spotting, Cloze, Synonyms-Antonyms

Tier-II (main)

Paper-I (compulsory for all): Mathematical Abilities, Reasoning, English Language & Comprehension, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge Module + Data Entry Speed Test (qualifying as applicable).

Paper-II (Statistics) and Paper-III (General Studies–Finance & Economics) only for specific posts (JSO / AAO etc.).

Official indicative syllabus PDF: ssc.gov.in.
